description.value: Take Out Shack is a small, independent fast-food counter in Vancouver's Gastown area specializing in smash burgers built around a playful comic-book theme centred on their mascot, Captain Sizzle. The menu spans beef and crispy chicken smash burgers, milkshakes, poutine-style burgers, and classic sides. A gluten-free bun substitution and no-charge lettuce-wrap option broaden accessibility for cyclists with dietary restrictions.
